messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed p99 in console flips order after a small fallback weight change. Looks like the legend sorts by percentile value rather than route priority.

maria: Can you paste the query and a screenshot?

alex: https://redwood.screenshots/ci/flight-174 (image)
alex: Query used: 
```sql
SELECT approx_quantile(latency_ms, 0.99) AS p99, route
FROM metrics.latency_rollups
WHERE env='prod' AND window='5m'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY p99 DESC
```

jen: Hmm ordering by p99 desc seems fine, but UX-wise the legend should reflect routing fallback order so it's easy to map to traffic flows.

samir: I suspect the p99 shown is computed after we merge sampled origins — when fallback kicks some traffic to cheaper model, the per-route sample counts change and approx_quantile on rollup can produce inversion.

kevin: Repro: toggling sample_origin=merged vs sample_origin=route shows the swap.

maria: So console is sorting the legend by displayed value but users think it's sorted by route priority. Bug or feature?

jen: I'd call it a UX mismatch. Two options: 1) keep value sort but add a clear 'sort by' control + tooltip; 2) default to route priority for multi-route stack traces.

alex: If we default to value sort we should at least show per-route sample counts and an origin badge. e.g., "p99=234ms (n=120k, origin=merged)"

samir: Also worth noting approx_quantile behavior: small sample size + t-digest merge can make tails noisy. For low-sample routes show a warning icon with link to docs.

jen: Proposal: hover tooltip shows: computed percentile, sample_count, origin tag (route/merged/fallback), and query time window. Also add a legend toggle to 'Sort by: Value | Route priority | Alphabetical'.

maria: Agreed. Add an experiment flag so we can A/B test default behavior for canary customers.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: console/legend-sort-experiment v2026.3 started on 3 hosts.

alex: Assigning to @samir for telemetry adjustments and @jen for console UI. I'll open an RFC and link the perf examples.

samir: Will add server-side tags: sample_origin and sample_count to the rollup API and bump schema version. Breaking change note in PR.

jen: I'll mock the tooltip and sorting control in figma by EOD.

kevin: One more: for SLO dashboards we should keep sorting by route priority to avoid accidental SLO noise chasing.

alex: Yeah SLO dashboards special case makes sense.

maria: ok lets sync in 30m in eng-platform standup. :thumbsup:

jen: :eyes:
